content: My recent PRs to mathlib are not passing CI, see e.g., https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/actions/runs/28709782017/job/85141589840?pr=40847 or https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/actions/runs/28710749904/job/85144318997?pr=41334 . The issue does not seem to be with the Lean code itself, but rather with scripts/export_crossrefs.lean which (according to my AI agent) was removed from master (and in particular its version of build_template.yml) but still part of the CI checks. My AI agent suggests that this problem may solve itself the next time the CI-tooling is bumped, but I thought I would flag it here in case anyone else is experiencing the same issue.
I experienced the same issue (for example in #32983), and I fixed it by merging master.

Weirdly, merging master fixed one of the builds but not the other. In any event it looks like this problem would solve itself soon, so probably no action is required, but still worth reporting, I think. EDIT: my failed build was from an unrelated issue. So merge master seems to be the universal fix in all cases.
Yes, this was due to #40701. Apologies for the inconvenience!
